title: 2026-11-25 — A decision resting on a fork's answer carries the trade the forks file measured

data.head: ## 2026-11-25 — A decision resting on a fork's answer carries the trade the forks file measured

body: At a wrap's Validate, check 7's fit reader reads a proposed decision row whose `rule` only restates what the code does — a field's type, a mark the read does not write — and whose `why` is empty as code retold (`not_master` type 4), even when the row records a fork's answer the plan expected. The reason exists: the chunk's `evidence/founder-forks.md` measured each option's cost. Raise such a decision as your own operation with the chosen option's trade in its `why` (what the rejected option would have cost), then fit reads it as a choice.

title: 2026-11-25 — `gate.py control` names a libtest unit case by its bare function name

data.head: ## 2026-11-25 — `gate.py control` names a libtest unit case by its bare function name

body: `gate.py control` matches a control's case against the test runner's names by suffix (`::{case}`), so a case inside a library's `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` is named by its bare function name, never its `module::tests::` path; the controls of a unit entry then read `holds` with the case named as written.

The session added virtual nodes declared: a canvas widget may now declare keyed, named, role-bearing regions inside its content box, and the Dioxus document reads them in process.
Each declaration carries a key, an AccessKit role taken as AccessKit's own Role type with no second mapping, a name and a region; the read validates them in declaration order and gives each taken one the reserved id {owner}///{key}.
Refusals are closed and per declaration: empty key, key holding a slash, a later duplicate key (the first kept), empty name, region outside the content box; a stale or non-canvas node reads no canvas, an unlaid canvas reads not laid out; no panic, no log site.
Nothing crosses: no declared node reaches the accessibility tree, the snapshot, the snapshot diff, the UI graph or any carrier, and a declaration change writes no changed-set mark and signals no reader.
The reserved id form moves from produced by nothing to produced in process by the declared-node read, still written by no walk and served by no carrier.
Every answer resting on this chunk is a delegate's and PROVISIONAL; the fork of whether a virtual node's name and key ride the accessible-name and stable-id exits stays the founder's, carried to the entry Virtual nodes as elements.

body:
The session added virtual nodes declared: an app's canvas widget declares keyed, named, role-bearing regions inside its content box, and the dioxus bridge reads and validates them in process.
The engine's widget trait gained a defaulted method returning no declarations and a declaration type (key, AccessKit role, name, region), behind the custom-widget feature; no engine code calls it.
The bridge gained an ungated read of a canvas's declared nodes: each taken node gets the reserved id {owner}///{key}; each refused declaration reads a closed reason (empty key, key holding a slash, duplicate key with the first kept, empty name, region outside the content box) with its index alone; a stale or non-canvas node reads no-canvas, an unlaid one not-laid-out.
The read has no panic path, no log site, print, span or field, no changed-set mark and no invalidation signal; no declared node reaches the snapshot, the graph or any carrier, and a check asserts that in both layout modes.
Every answer behind it is a delegate's and lands PROVISIONAL; the names' crossing to the accessibility tree and the invalidation and changed-set mark stay deferred to the later virtual-nodes-as-elements entry.
No dependency, manifest, CI workflow, gate, telemetry sink or driver verb changed; nothing was retired.

body: decision/debug-types-never-logged: the answer-bearing types never logged gain the declared-node types (the declaration, the taken node, the refusal, the read's answer and its unread reason).
The canvas read and the layout read open no span: a new sibling in-process read, of a canvas's declared nodes, likewise opens no span and records no field.

Engine log sites write fixed messages and escher-session diagnostics are fixed strings: the declared-node read adds no log site, print or diagnostic, so no fixed-message rule gains an entry or an exception.
Session logs carry no page content and content-named span values are never stored: a declared node's name and key are app content that stays in process, written to no log, span or answer.

The graph answer, the snapshot node and the snapshot text (content, clickable): unchanged by the read; a declaring canvas adds no node, no reserved id and no declared name to the snapshot or the graph, asserted by a check.

Escher crates take tracing ungated and the engine's tracing stays behind its feature: the bridge's ungated module list gains the declared-node module, which takes no tracing; the engine side is behind the custom-widget feature and logs nothing.
Driver emits no event and its command span carries no content: no verb, span field or command answer gains a declared node; the canvas field of the command span is unchanged.

Refusal cause names: the declared-node refusals (empty key, key holding a slash, duplicate key, empty name, region outside) and unread reasons (no canvas, not laid out) are a separate in-process set, not driver refusal causes, and no carrier prints them.

body_fields.fact: The declared-node read of a canvas (its validation and its answer) has no log site, print, span or field; a refused declaration is a closed reason with its index alone, and nothing of it is logged (PROVISIONAL, a delegate's answer).
The declared-node read opens no span, like the canvas read and the layout read.

A declared virtual node's name, key and reserved id stay in process: no snapshot, graph, span or log carries them until the virtual-nodes-as-elements entry decides their crossing (PROVISIONAL, deferred to the founder's fork).

body: contract/stable-element-id/virtual-node-form: the reserved form {owner}///{key} moves from produced by nothing to produced in process for a canvas's taken declared nodes, written by no walk and served by no carrier; no served id holds /// still holds.

contract/stable-element-id/no-collision and contract/stable-element-id/derivation: a declared key holding a slash or empty is refused, and a later duplicate key refused with the first kept, so a virtual node id cannot collide with a walked id or another virtual node of the same canvas.
contract/stable-element-id/carriers and decision/stable-id-exits: a new kind of stable id now exists in process; it reaches no ratified exit this chunk.

decision/accessible-name-exits and decision/attribute-text-leaves-by-ratified-carriers: an app-authored declared name now exists in process; it crosses no exit, and whether it rides the accessible-name exits stays the founder's deferred fork.
decision/canvas-content-crossing, decision/graph-answer-crossing and contract/graph-answer/nodes-states: a declaring canvas puts nothing on the graph answer; measured in both layout modes.
contract/snapshot-text/id-field and contract/snapshot-text/name-field: the snapshot holds no virtual node id and no declared name.

decision/accessibility-adapter-content-classes, decision/author-id-on-accessibility-nodes and decision/accessibility-tree-refresh-on-change: declared nodes are not in the accessibility tree and raise no refresh or invalidation signal this chunk.

decision/custom-widget-content-box-frame: a declared region is validated against the canvas content box, the final layout size less border and padding per axis floored at 0; a region fitting the border box but not the content box is refused.

decision/no-panic-on-call-input and decision/stale-node-ids-never-panic: the declared-node read resolves its canvas by element id then node lookup; a stale or non-canvas node reads NoCanvas and an unlaid one NotLaidOut, no panic.

decision/closed-refusal-cause-set, decision/refusal-closed-cause-set and decision/refusal-holds-no-call-input: a second closed refusal set now stands beside the driver's, per declaration, holding its index and reason alone; it is no driver refusal cause and crosses no carrier.
decision/one-validation-path-for-every-carrier and decision/single-validation-gate: the declaration validation is an in-process path of its own, reached by no carrier and no driver verb.

decision/accessible-names-not-logged, decision/stable-id-not-logged and decision/no-screen-content-in-logs: the declared-node read has no log site, print, span or field; declared names and virtual node ids reach no log.

decision/session-layout-read-in-process and decision/no-process-handle-crosses: the new read takes a NodeId in process, beside the in-process layout read; no process-local handle crosses with a virtual node id.
decision/unknown-id-refused-stale-or-not-found and contract/stable-element-id/unresolved-node: a stale canvas node is refused in the declared-node read as NoCanvas, the in-process analogue of stale.

decision/boundary-widening-rule and decision/closed-value-field-no-widening: an engine API addition (a defaulted trait method and a type behind the custom-widget feature) and a public bridge read are added with no carrier field; flagged upstreamable, nothing sent.
contract/driver-verbs/canvas and name/command/canvas: the canvas verb's answer gains nothing from declared nodes.

body_fields.fact: Virtual nodes on carriers are absent: a canvas's declared virtual nodes, their {owner}///{key} ids and declared names cross no carrier (snapshot, graph, canvas answer, accessibility tree, MCP); whether name and key ride the accessible-name and stable-id exits stays the founder's fork, deferred (PROVISIONAL).

App-declared virtual nodes are validated by their reader in declaration order against a closed refusal set (EmptyKey, KeyHoldsSlash, DuplicateKey with the first kept, EmptyName, RegionOutside the canvas content box, NaN and infinities failing); a refusal holds the declaration's index and reason alone, with no panic path (PROVISIONAL on the duplicate rule).
The declared-node read refuses a stale or non-canvas node as NoCanvas and a canvas before its first layout as NotLaidOut, a closed set, never panicking.
The declared-node read and its validation hold no log site, print, span or field; declared names, keys and virtual node ids reach no log.
A declared virtual node's role is AccessKit's Role itself with no second mapping, and validation reads no role (PROVISIONAL).

body: Dependency security: no dependency, manifest, lock, audit, licence or pin changed.
Secret management and environment variables: nothing reads an environment variable or secret.
API security: no listener, socket bound, outbound request, load wait or idle expiry changed; the session socket and MCP server are unchanged.
Authentication and authorization, CI tokens and publish guards: untouched.
Data protection: kept checks, recordings, history, cookies, cache and TLS are unchanged.
Driver session wire grammar, CLI flags, exit codes, MCP protocol errors and session error tables: no verb, flag, reply or error added.
Select list, range, password masking, form controls, script fetch, HTML and CSS parsing rows: no change reaches them.
Cold-agent, agent-run, coverage floor, WPT and apt-install script rows: no script or harness changed.

The session let an app declare virtual nodes inside a canvas: keyed, named, role-bearing regions, each one validated and given the reserved id owner///key.
The engine gained a defaulted widget trait method, virtual_nodes, and a declaration type behind the custom-widget feature. Nothing in the engine calls the method, no existing widget implementation was edited, and the addition is flagged upstreamable.
The dioxus bridge gained an ungated in-process read, DioxusDocument::virtual_nodes. A stale or non-canvas node reads NoCanvas and an unlaid canvas reads NotLaidOut. Declarations are checked in order, and a failing one gets a closed reason: EmptyKey, KeyHoldsSlash, DuplicateKey (the first is kept), EmptyName, or RegionOutside the content box. The read never panics and has no log site.
The reserved owner///key form is now produced in process for a canvas's taken nodes. No walk writes it and no carrier serves it: snapshot and graph still hold no ///. There is no changed-set mark and no invalidation signal.
Nine unit cases and one new integration target with three cases were added. Each integration case runs in both layout modes, and 14 controls held. CI on the final HEAD was green, 17 of 17 checks.
No dependency, manifest, CI, gate or harness surface changed. Nothing was retired.

body_fields.what: the engine's custom widget trait that an app widget implements (paint, layout); it now holds the virtual-node declaration type and the defaulted virtual_nodes method
the engine's node module and its public re-exports of the widget items
the engine crate root, the blitz-dom public surface and its re-exports
the dioxus bridge crate root, its module list and its public re-export list, where the ungated modules stand
the bridge's stable element ids, holding the reserved owner-key virtual form and virtual_node_id with its unit tests
new bridge module for the in-process read of a canvas's declared virtual nodes, its validation, and its inline unit test module

new blitz-tests integration test target with one behaviour per file; it checks declared nodes in the content box, a widget that declares nothing, and that a declaring canvas puts nothing on the snapshot or graph, in both layout modes

body: The element-id virtual form row and the reserved owner-key graph id form decision: the form owner///key is now produced in process by the bridge's declared-node read for a canvas's taken nodes. No walk writes it and no carrier serves it, so no served id holds ///.

The unit test strategy's scope for the dioxus bridge: the bridge's unit scope now covers the declared-node validation. That means each refusal reason, a region touching the content edges, the owner-key id of a taken node, an unlaid canvas, and a stale or non-canvas node.
Rows saying bridge tests are a child of the dioxus document and test without widening visibility: the new unit module is such a child and calls the crate-private validate.

Unit tests sit in inline test modules in their source file: the new module follows this. Its fixtures use the default role so that it names no accessibility item, because the bridge's accesskit dependency is optional under the accessibility feature.

One integration test target per behaviour and per file: blitz-tests gains the auto-discovered target virtual_nodes_declared with three cases, and no manifest changed. The blitz-tests manifest rows hold.
Layout and stand checks run in both layout modes: every case of the new target loops over incremental off and on.

Tests controlled red-before-green, and control edits leave earlier targets green: 14 controls held for this chunk. One of them shows the content-box subtraction going red without it, and one shows the unlaid canvas reading NotLaidOut.

The graph and snapshot answers of the driver session, and graph answer holds no value: the new crossing check asserts that snapshot and graph through Session::run hold no /// and no planted name while a canvas declares nodes. Its live-needle precondition is asserted first.

Shared fixtures in one module, and test data in code: the new target declares the shared fixtures module and builds its snapshot and graph calls in-file as escher_driver Call. All of its declaration data is stated in code.
The stand-repeat named list and requirement witnessing inside stand-repeat: the new target is no stand_ target. The stand-repeat list does not gain it, and no row's count moves.

The decision on no screenshot step in committed checks, in its one-host clause (screenshot repeatability asserted on one host only): this is now stale. Canvas-only shot digests, whole and as the canvas element in both layout modes, plus Circle Drawer's canvas element shot, equal one committed table on linux, windows and macOS. A shot holding page text still differs across hosts, so the committed-check half and its reason stand.
Per-crate coverage floors: the bridge crate gains a new module and its nine unit cases. The floors are unchanged and no row's floor value moves.

body_fields.fact: The bridge's declared-node read is unit-tested in its own inline module. There is one case per refusal reason (empty key, key holding a slash, later duplicate refused with the first kept, empty name, region outside the content box), plus a region touching the content edges taken, a taken node reading its owner///key id, an unlaid canvas reading NotLaidOut, and a stale or non-canvas node reading NoCanvas. Each is controlled red-before-green.

A declaring canvas putting nothing on the snapshot or graph is asserted in both layout modes, with no mutation control. The control is owed once code exists that could carry a virtual node to a carrier.

body: CI integration rows (legs, caches, matrix, package installs, actions pinning, secrets, permissions, trigger branches, MSRV): no workflow, leg script or manifest changed.
Cold-agent and agent-run rows (events, verbs, exit codes, verdicts, selections, isolation): untouched.
Session wire, session host, state directory, recording and escher-session command-line, MCP role and exit-code contracts: no verb, carrier, bound or wire shape changed.
WPT runner, conformance and expectations rows: untouched.
Mocking and stand-in rows, virtual clock, advance and timer-tick rows, and harness settle and time contracts: untouched.

Lint defects and findings, contrast reading, handler coverage, and driver refusal-cause rows (covered, off-screen, disabled, stale): unchanged. Virtual nodes taking clicks or being refused is deferred to a later entry.
Quality gate rows on mutation runs, the complexity ceiling, oversize targets, the zero-failure budget and the coverage exclusions: no threshold or exclusion moved.
